sections.overview: This Mediterranean hawk moth is associated with pine woods.
sections.identification: It closely resembles Sphinx pinastri; genitalia help distinguish them.
sections.habitat: Its range includes North Africa, Iberia and parts of southern France.
sections.diet: Larvae feed on pines; cedar is also reported.
sections.behavior: The two species may meet; hybrids are reported in contact zones.
sections.reproduction: The consulted accounts do not establish a reliable breeding schedule.
sections.ecology: See Sphinx pinastri, its similar northern relative.
sections.conservation: The consulted species accounts provide no global conservation rank.
